messages.text: BL-1952 🎵 in progress — Stamp-off for hotfixes 3e66c4af7c, c44825d8e4, d955df1ca4, 7d47d8bf63 and 4afdfbb6bf: a local-model seat's context budget - no re-attached files after a compaction (a two-file read had stopped the iq3 coder on qwen's hard limit), compaction summaries capped at 1200 tokens, asked for without an <analysis> block, closed when cut and never empty (76% of its model time went to compacting), and a short seat system prompt with auto memory off (its first request fell from 12487 to 4761 tokens)
